items.title: Buckingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: like Maybelle Carter had a lick.

ctx.x: I see. And one of the — I don’t know if it was a student or something asked — actually at one of the YouTube comments was how can she play guitar with those long nails. And you actually answered it.

Well I’ll tell you now again, when she gets serious about the songwriting, the acrylic nails come off. And she plays. I mean she’s got, like I say, a great lick, like Maybelle Carter had a lick. And Dolly has a really good lick on the guitar, clawhammer banjo, dulcimer and autoharp. But the way she does it live, with the nails, and they’re acrylic, and she can do the nails as a percussive instrument. That’s how she wrote “9 to 5.” I can’t do it ‘cause I can’t make that noise, but she could make that noise, it…

it’s all open tunings. ‘Cause if you watch her she’s barring the chords. And sometimes will stick a finger in to make it a minor or a seventh or whatever. But it’s all bar. It’s all open tuning, usually in D.
